title: Mypy plugin: subclasses must defer while a Pydantic base class is still unprocessed (import cycles)
answers: mypy plugin crash with import cycle between models
mypy says unexpected keyword argument for an inherited field of a subclass
base class fields missing from generated __init__ signature in mypy plugin
why does pydantic mypy plugin set pydantic-mypy-metadata-tag
body:
Symptom: with the pydantic mypy plugin, a subclass whose base model has a forward reference back to the subclass (TYPE_CHECKING import cycle) crashes the plugin, or gets an `__init__` signature that is missing the base's fields (issue #11329).
Root cause: pydantic/mypy.py:PydanticModelTransformer.collect_fields_and_class_vars skipped any MRO entry without METADATA_KEY. If the base's own transform was deferred (unresolved forward ref), the subclass was finalized without the base's fields.
Fix pattern: PydanticModelTransformer.transform tags every class it starts on with `info.metadata.setdefault(METADATA_TAG_KEY, {})`. When a base has METADATA_TAG_KEY but no METADATA_KEY (started but not finished), collect_fields_and_class_vars returns (None, None). transform then calls `self._api.defer()` and returns False, so another semantic-analysis pass runs.
Constraints: only defer when `not self._api.final_iteration`. On the final iteration, fall through or mypy cannot terminate. Non-Pydantic bases have neither key and are still skipped. Any new 'not ready yet' path in transform should follow the same defer-unless-final pattern.
applies: pydantic/mypy.py plugin model transformation and inheritance handling
